source_text: Custodite praecepta mea et facite ea. Auditus sine facto surdus. Qui facit voluntatem manet.
pass_a_gloss: Keep precepts my and do them. Hearing without deed deaf. Who does will remains.
pass_b_english: [[Keep my statutes and do them >> Bible:Leviticus 19:37]]. Hearing without doing is deaf. Who does the will remains.
